items.title: Ken Colyer Interview, 1959-09-21
items.q: i spent a night listening to kid thomas over the river and aldears

ctx.x: and that's the band well you you have of course been keeping close contact with new orleans your friends there and with america through records uh have you learned any recorded music particularly that you've heard since you well you have been back to new orleans of course haven't you first of all
